args.summary: Deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) resulted in failed health checks and an elevated error rate (~18%). Remediation: rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Current status is v2.3.0 rolled out everywhere; health/error rate should be monitored to confirm full recovery. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation before any re-deploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Investigation**
- checkout-api was on **v2.3.1** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an ~18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc in staging was also unhealthy).

**Remediation**
- Rolled **checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions**. Verified the service is now healthy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west, with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the need to investigate the v2.3.1 root cause before any re-deploy attempt. The on-call engineer has been paged.
